# Exchange Docs Hub

> Links to official exchange API documentation in LLM-friendly formats (Binance, Hyperliquid, Aster, Polymarket). Links only; no mirrored content.
> Status labels: verified = body checked at recorded time; unverified = candidate not yet checked; blocked = fetch failed.
> Sources: 20 total; 20 verified, 0 unverified, 0 blocked.

- [llms-full: Complete Binance Developer Docs as one text file (about 8 MB)](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/llms-full.txt) [verified]
- [markdown: USDS-M Futures general API information (raw Markdown)](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/products/derivatives-trading-usds-futures/general-info.md) [verified]
